ops.body:
Refuter pass complete 2026-07-25 (gpt-5.6-sol, --lane refute --schema refutations, told to default to refuted and to weigh the lane.lock generation protocol first). None refuted. Two downgraded, three confirmed, two new defects surfaced.

**1 — REVISED, blocker -> major.** classify() does read the reply path straight from meta (registry.go:184-186) and passes it unvalidated plus ".tmp" to os.Remove (registry.go:249-250), despite being documented read-only (registry.go:167-168). Downgraded because exploitation needs a corrupted or crafted same-user tool-owned lane. Fix: remove cleanup from classify, or do it under the lane lock and only for a lane-local codex-r-* path.

**2 — REVISED, blocker -> major.** The XDG-derived base is accepted and created unchecked (registry.go:67-74), cleaning is only lexical (registry.go:568), and prune follows directory symlinks (registry.go:320-321, :335-336, :350-353). Downgraded because it needs a misconfigured or hostile same-user XDG value or a precreated symlink, and a final symlink is merely unlinked. Fix: reject relative XDG values, canonicalize and guard the base before creation, skip symlink entries, verify prune targets stay beneath the canonical base.

**3 — CONFIRMED.** registry.go:237-238 classifies every meta-without-pid lane as pending with no age limit, and registry.go:415-418 loops indefinitely on pending, while status.go:55-59 stops after 60 polls at 250ms (status.go:73) — i.e. --await bounds the window at ~15s and --watch does not. Fix: share a registration-grace constant; classify meta-without-pid as died once mtime exceeds it.

**4 — CONFIRMED.** dispatch.go removes and republishes meta while holding the exclusive lock (dispatch.go:227-250, acquired :153), but registry.go:350-353 does terminal reclassification and RemoveAll without acquiring any lock, and no-run is terminal (main.go:34). Fix: acquire the exclusive lane lock before the final age/state checks and hold it through RemoveAll.

**5 — CONFIRMED.** status.go:19-26 acquires the lock before checking for meta, and registry.go:86-87 opens lane.lock with O_CREATE; main.go:64-65 routes --await there with no guard. Fix: resolve sdir, run the canonicalized rejectOutsideScratch guard, then acquire.

**MISSED-1 (new, major)** — registry.go:415: --watch holds no shared generation lock, so reuse can expose the transient no-run state or silently switch the watch to a replacement generation.

**MISSED-2 (new, major)** — status.go:146: readPid accepts PID 0, and kill(0, 0) succeeds, so a corrupt statusless lane with no lstart reads as running indefinitely.

Caveat: finding 4's dispatch.go line numbers were read while an unrelated edit was in flight in the same working copy; registry.go/status.go cites are unaffected. Re-anchor dispatch.go cites before acting on 4.

Clustering note for whoever implements: 1, 4 and MISSED-1 all touch the classify/prune/watch lock protocol and should land as one coherent change rather than parallel worktrees. 2 and MISSED-2 are separable. 3 and 5 are being built now in an isolated worktree.
